title: A Study of Adalimumab for the Maintenance of Clinical Remission in Japanese Subjects With Crohn's Disease
brief_summary: To demonstrate the efficacy and safety of adalimumab for the maintenance of clinical remission in Japanese subjects with Crohn's disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who successfully enrolled in and completed the M04-729, (NCT00445939) study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject is considered by the investigator, for any reason, to be an unsuitable candidate for the study
